automated.summary: Full factory suite green on the frozen tree. New tests: assert_target_destination refuses every escape route (symlinked destination/ancestor, .. traversal, .. inside a missing suffix, symlink loop, in-target symlink pointing outside, and a .. that normalizes back onto a real in-target symlink); the file-variant refuses a directory (copy2 container) and a symlink-out while allowing an in-target symlink to a file and a dangling in-target symlink; per-command init/adopt/upgrade escape tests assert a symlinked destination and ancestor are refused before any write (clean abort); and the cross-module structural anti-reopen scan (AST) fails on any raw filesystem mutation outside the shared helper across scaffold/adopt/upgrade.
commands_run: uv run --with pytest python -m pytest factory/tests/test_gates.py -q -k "no_raw_write or upgrade or adopt or init or scaffold or assert_target or record_origin"
